card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a $80,000 allowance optional claimer. Three of them want the lead. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 5 points. We make the favourite, #8 LITTLE THUNDER, 16% against the board's 22%, shorter than we think it should be. Our own top-rated is #3 SHOW TIME. We are not betting the race; take it as an opinion, not a play.
